Name: Sevinae of Alchemistry (Stardew Druid)
Author: neosinf
Description:
===========================================
Stardew Druid: Sevinae of Alchemistry
===========================================

Sevinae yearns for adventure and the friendship of a powerful alchemist druid!

This mod doesn't do anything on it's own. Instead it tells Stardew Druid, the main mod, to enable recruitment of the Sevinae character in Mage's Rest (Alchemistry) when using the Recruit Hero effect.

[color=#f6b26b]NOTE: Because the assets for this mod are packaged in Stardew Druid, this extension does not need to be downloaded and installed to be enabled for players who have 'heroic crossovers' set to true in their Stardew Druid configuration file.
[/color]
This mod can be enabled and disabled without affecting save files or progression in Stardew Druid.

Check out heroes from other crossovers here!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32958]Sophia, Blue Moon Avenger
[/url]
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32743]Lance of the First Slash[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32396]Astarion of Baldur's Village[/url]

------------------------------------
Future development
------------------------------------

Morghoula is a friend and I'm thrilled to be able to provide this compatibility mod for Sevinae. 

I have offered to add additional dialogue, behaviours and other quest content at Morghoula's discretion, however, I'm not sure what/when/if that will eventuate.

------------------------------------
Sevinae looks different
------------------------------------

That's because this is my artistic vision for Sevinae based on the high definition portraits, and it's also in order to align Sevinae's sprite animations with the Stardew Druid character model.

------------------------------------
How do I recruit Sevinae?
------------------------------------

If you're familiar with Stardew Druid, and you've unlocked the Gift of the Heiress in your playthrough, then you'll know what to do, just cast Rite of Mists: Smite on Sevinae when you see her onscreen.

Open the Hero's ledger menu from the Stardew Druid journal screen, and then click on Sevinae's entry, then click the check box to summon her.

If you are not interested in a Druid playthrough, you can use the set progress feature in the Stardew Druid configuration to skip right to the Gift of the Heiress unlock, which is progress 30.

Alternatively, the recruit system is immediately available for Magic only mode users of Stardew Druid.
